newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian Prime Minister Prodi to go to Albania.
newsitem.headline: Italian Prime Minister Prodi to go to Albania.

text.p: Prime Minister Romano Prodi will go to Albania on Sunday as Italy prepares to head a multinational security mission to the troubled Balkan state, a spokesman for Prodi said on Saturday.
He said Prodi would make a one-day visit to Tirana but gave no further details. Prodi said on Saturday Italy would begin deploying the bulk of its 2,500 troops to Albania from next Tuesday.
The 6,000 strong multinational force was sanctioned by the United Nations Security Council and aims to protect the delivery of aid supplies.
Troops from France, Greece, Spain, Turkey and Romania will also take part.
